digest.component_or_area: ADR (Architecture Decision Record) numbering and indexing
propositions: ADR files in docs/adr/ have duplicate numbers (91 files, 69 distinct numbers, 22 duplicates across 17 collision groups)
Collisions result from stale-base merges and in-flight races; pre-merge CI uniqueness checks are racy by construction

Per-number marker files at docs/adr/.numbers/NNNN (with filename as content) prevent collisions via add/add git conflicts, eliminating false-positive concurrent-addition conflicts vs. shared-index approaches
Renumbered 22 duplicate ADRs to 0070-0091 (earliest-landed keeps original number; movers assigned by ascending landing-date order)
All slug-bearing ADR cross-references in docs/ and src/ that named moved ADRs are rewritten to their new numbers; referential integrity is asserted by CI gate
The gate scripts/check_adr_numbers.py validates ADR↔marker bijection, unique numbers, unique marker content, and that all markdown adr/*-slug links resolve to existing files
